article.title: Holder of first acquired part entitled to all
article.content: As between holders in due course of different parts of the same set, he who first acquired title to his part is entitled to the other parts and the money represented by the bill.
article.html:
133Holder of first acquired part entitled to all

Section 133 · Chapter XV · page 27 of the Act

As between holders in due course of different parts of the same set, he who first acquired title to his part is entitled to the other parts and the money represented by the bill.
